analysis_notes.duplicate_edge_note: The single bechina edge (קנאת ה צבאות ↔ צדקה) appears twice in torahData.js with reference 1065 — both entries are identical. This is a data duplication, not two distinct edges. It has been treated as a single edge in the analysis.
analysis_notes.torah_text_coverage: Torah LM2 #65 is a very brief teaching (4 sentences). Its single explicit bechina statement — 'קנאת ה' צבאות נחשב כמו צדקה' — is fully captured by the one edge in the dataset. The proof text citing Tosafot and the story of Nevuzaradan serves as the evidentiary basis for the equivalence, but introduces no additional bechina concepts. There are no missing nodes and no orphaned nodes.
analysis_notes.evil_mirror_note: This Torah has no evil counterpart discussed. The teaching is entirely in the positive domain — it establishes the spiritual equivalence of two acts of holiness. No sitra achra or opposing force is mentioned. There is therefore no evil mirror package to identify.
